method_classification.source: non-adaptive baseline; evaluation mode is fixed throughout the stream
method_classification.ema_restore: diagnostic control; not claimed as CoTTA

primary_endpoint_definition: checkpoint_source_accuracy minus clean-return accuracy before return adaptation
metric_only_label_use: labels are read only after logits are detached to score pre-update online target predictions
corrections: keep the non-adaptive source baseline in evaluation mode so BatchNorm running statistics cannot change
measure parameter drift before return-stage evaluation and adaptation
record registered target-stream accuracy and entropy from pre-update predictions
abca_c_domain_rationale: fixed outside the B shift-family factor to prevent B-family comparisons from changing the C-domain intervention
stop_rules: stop a dataset if source balanced accuracy is below 0.50 after source training
withdraw a mechanism claim if prospective predictors fail held-seed validation
do not mark modern-baseline coverage complete until independent published implementations pass
do not promote the superseded formal result set to evidence
